Blockquote containing a list preserves list items inside quote

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<blockquote><p>Quote intro:</p><ul><li>Point one</li><li>Point two</li></ul></blockquote>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result)

main()
```
